descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S08 Chart → list → switch → browser Back → re-open: the page always matches its URL's context

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 No data or template leakage between Hospital and Nursing Home. This covers lists, charts, the template picker, custom templates, account-wide screens (search, dashboard counts, Task Export, Inbox, mu … (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U1c The summary label is 'Background Summary' in Hospital and 'Admission Summary' in Nursing Home (UAT TC-21 step 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fixture patients; the Hospital patient's chart open on Pre-Round. The switch exists only on the list screens, not inside a chart (2026-10-10 S08 run).

When From the chart use the app's back control to the list, switch to Nursing Home, press browser Back once, then re-open the same URL with browser_navigate (stands in for a reload)

Then The Hospital chart is the Hospital chart (Background Summary). The Nursing Home list never lists the Hospital patient. After Back and after re-open, the Hospital page shows the Hospital patient and not the resident.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint. Route-independent content decides, because the URL check is dead (R1): 'Background Summary' marks the Hospital chart, and own patient present / other absent marks the list.

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
